name: Oikko – All-in-One Team Management
author: WP Plugin Studio

sections.description:
Oikko – All-in-One Team Management lets you manage your team efficiently with modules for chat, attendance, HR, leave, and documents.

🆓 Free Version Features

✔ User-to-user chat
✔ Clock-in/out and time reports
✔ Update personal profile information
✔ Upload & manage documents
✔ Add/edit users, assign roles & designations
✔ Convert time zones easily
✔ Create/edit departments & assign users
✔ Manage designations & assign users
✔ Create/edit shifts & assign users

💎 Pro Version Features

All Free features PLUS:

⭐ Group Chat – Create chat groups for seamless collaboration.
⭐ Audio/Video Calls – Built-in user-to-user calls for instant communication.
⭐ Channel Management – Organize team discussions, assign users to channels.
⭐ Leave Requests – Easy leave request creation with approval tracking.
⭐ Leave Management – Full leave management with custom types and workflows.
⭐ Salary Management – Assign salaries, manage payroll with full edit/delete.

🔗 Get Pro: Oikko Team Management Pro

Shortcodes

  • [oikkotm_dashboard] – Display the Plugin Frontend Dashboard.

Privacy

This plugin can optionally connect to the OpenStreetMap Nominatim API
(https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org) to convert coordinates into location
names. This feature is disabled by default and can be turned on or off anytime
from the plugin settings. No personal or identifiable data is transmitted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oikko-team-management folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Setup Oikko Team Management from the WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
Can I track multiple users?

Yes, clock-in/out and reporting works for all users in the free version. Pro adds enhanced reporting and leave management for multiple users.

Does it include chat?

Yes, Free version allows one-to-one chat. Pro includes Group Chat, Audio/Video Calls, and Channel Management for real-time team communication.

Can I manage leave requests?

Free version does not include leave management. Pro allows users to submit leave requests and gives admins full leave management with custom types and approval workflows.

Can I manage salaries?

Salary management is only available in Pro. You can set default currency, assign salaries, and manage payroll with full edit/delete capabilities.

Is it compatible with WordPress 6.2+?

Yes, fully tested with WordPress 6.2 up to 6.9.

Can I upgrade from Free to Pro without losing data?

Yes, your existing users, chats, and documents remain intact when you upgrade to Pro.
